messages.author: Antigravity
messages.content:
Welcome to **hellyeah** (`v0.1.0 — Genesis`).Right now, this app is a clean slate—just our live communication link and an open stage.

Tell me what you want this app to become, or pick one of the evolution suggestions. Whatever you write here triggers a live mutation in `/home/antigravity/hellyeah` and hot-reloads the interface in real time.

suggestions.title: Personal Command Deck & Pomodoro Studio
suggestions.description: Add a tactile focus timer, daily intent tracker, and ambient sound synthesizer directly onto the stage.
suggestions.prompt: Evolve the stage into a Personal Command Deck with a tactile Pomodoro focus timer, a quick task queue with keyboard shortcuts, and a live session streak tracker.

suggestions.title: Interactive Synth & Generative Audio Pad
suggestions.description: Turn the canvas into a playable WebAudio polyphonic XY pad with real-time waveform visualization.
suggestions.prompt: Add a playable WebAudio synthesizer and XY expression pad with live oscilloscope visuals and preset chords.

suggestions.title: Live Markdown & Idea Graph Scratchpad
suggestions.description: Create interconnected thought cards that auto-save to disk and link concepts visually.
suggestions.prompt: Build an interactive spatial note-taking board where I can create, drag, filter, and link thought cards that persist to disk.

suggestions.title: Real-Time System & Codebase Inspector
suggestions.description: Let the app inspect its own source files in /home/antigravity/hellyeah and edit its own CSS variables live.
suggestions.prompt: Add a live self-inspector module that displays the files inside /home/antigravity/hellyeah and lets me tweak the app's live theme tokens and layout.

changelog.summary: Initialized hellyeah core with SSE hot-reload, Antigravity file-bridge, suggestion engine, and modular stage.
